text: 问：10月23日，美财政部发布新版对外投资限制拟议规则，征求公众评论意见。请问中方对此有何评论？ 答：中方注意到有关情况。该拟议规则歧视性扩大对华投资限制范围，加大限制力度，是典型的泛化国家安全做法，违背两国元首达成的重要共识，干扰中美两国企业正常经贸合作，破坏国际经贸秩序。中方对此表示严重关切、坚决反对，将密切关注事态后续发展，保留采取相应措施的权利。 中国拥有超大规模市场，蕴含巨大消费和投资潜力，投资中国就是投资未来。美方限制对华投资，既不利于中美经贸合作，也会损害美国企业自身利益。中方敦促美方尊重市场经济规律，停止泛化国家安全概念，停止将经贸问题政
text_en: Q: On October 23, the US Treasury Department released a new proposed rule on outbound investment restrictions and solicited public comments. What is China's comment on this? A: China has noted the situation. The proposed rule discriminatorily expands the scope of investment restrictions on China and increases the intensity of restrictions. It is a typical practice of overgeneralizing national security, violates the important consensus reached by the two heads of state, disrupts normal economic and trade cooperation between Chinese and US enterprises, and undermines the international economic and trade order. China expresses serious concern and firm opposition, will closely follow the subsequent development of the situation, and reserves the right to take corresponding measures. China has a super-large market with huge consumption and investment potential; investing in China is investing in the future. US restrictions on investment in China are neither conducive to China-US economic and trade cooperation nor in the interest of US companies themselves. China urges the US to respect the laws of the market economy, stop overgeneralizing the concept of national security, and stop turning economic and trade issues into political
